name: Mixpanel
description: Mixpanel is a product analytics platform for Events, Properties, Insights, Funnels, Retention, Cohorts, user journeys, experiments, and behavioral reporting.
agentUseSummary: Enter one dedicated Mixpanel Service Account username/secret, exact numeric Project ID, and allowlisted US, EU, or India API origin. Relay validates authentication and Project Annotation authority, then exposes only the binding summary, twenty-five content-free Cohort aggregate/lifecycle summaries, and twenty-five Annotation ID/date summaries over at most 31 days; profiles, identity, raw events, classified data, detailed reports, private content, arbitrary queries, exports, and writes remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_API_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel API origin
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter https://mixpanel.com for US, https://eu.mixpanel.com for EU, or https://in.mixpanel.com for India data residency. Relay rejects every other origin.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel Project ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact numeric Project ID to which the dedicated Service Account has least-role read access.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel Service Account username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated Service Account for the exact Project with the least role that can read Cohorts and Annotations.

credentialRequirements.name: MIXPANEL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Mixpanel Service Account secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Record the secret when shown. Prefer an explicit expiration and rotate by replacing or deleting the Service Account.

capabilities.label: Project binding
capabilities.description: Validate one exact Project-authorized Service Account and regional origin.

capabilities.label: Cohort aggregates
capabilities.description: List bounded saved Cohort aggregate/lifecycle summaries.

capabilities.label: Annotation metadata
capabilities.description: List bounded Annotation lifecycle metadata over a short explicit range.

allowed.label: Read Project binding
allowed.description: Validate the exact regional origin, Service Account credentials, and numeric Project ID without returning Service Account identity.

allowed.label: List Cohort aggregates
allowed.description: Read at most twenty-five saved Cohort aggregate/lifecycle summaries without names, descriptions, definitions, or member profiles.

allowed.label: List Annotation lifecycle metadata
allowed.description: Read at most twenty-five Annotation IDs/dates in an explicit range of no more than 31 days without descriptions, users, or tags.

blocked.label: Access profiles or identity
blocked.description: Profiles, identities, user activity, cohort members, traits, classified data, and person-level exports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access events or detailed reports
blocked.description: Raw events, event/property names and values, report series, funnel steps, retention, breakdowns, JQL, and raw exports are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access private configuration content
blocked.description: Cohort names/descriptions/definitions, Annotation descriptions/authors/tags, saved-report names, boards, and workspace content are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Mixpanel data
blocked.description: Ingesting events/profiles, creating, updating, deleting, annotating, administering, or changing Mixpanel resources is outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary requests
blocked.description: Arbitrary projects, origins, paths, report IDs, queries, expressions, dates beyond 31 days, pagination, crawling, synchronization, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Three bounded aggregate/lifecycle reads run automatically; profiles, identity, raw events, detailed reports, content, broader queries, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact regional-origin and Project binding, provider roles, fixed limits, short date ranges, audit, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts three bounded Mixpanel read wrappers and attaches the encrypted Service Account credentials, exact Project ID, and validated regional origin server-side.
Railway mounts three bounded Mixpanel read wrappers and attaches the encrypted Service Account credentials, exact Project ID, and validated regional origin server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: The customer creates a dedicated least-role Service Account for the exact Project, records the one-time secret, preferably sets an expiration, supplies the correct regional origin and Project ID, and deletes or replaces the Service Account for provider-side revocation.

evidence.supports: Mixpanel recommends Service Accounts, documents HTTP Basic auth, Project/Workspace roles, one-time secrets, optional expiration, and deletion-based revocation.
Mixpanel requires exact project_id with Service Account Query API calls and may filter classified data based on Service Account sensitivity settings.
POST /api/query/cohorts/list returns saved Cohort name, ID, count, description, creation date, Project ID, and visibility; Relay strips names/descriptions and limits output to 25.
GET /api/app/projects/{projectId}/annotations uses Service Account auth, supports explicit dates, and returns descriptions, users, and tags; Relay limits 31 days/25 rows and returns only IDs/dates.
Mixpanel documents Query API limits of five concurrent queries and 60 queries per hour.
